Fed hawkishness caps upside. Crypto momentum likely continues short-term on regulatory clarity. Aviation names offer tactical buys post-ATC disruption.

Fed rate path remains the dominant macro variable. Paramount-WBD consolidation reshapes media landscape. EM benefits from trade normalization. Political risk (midterms, policy shifts) creates episodic volatility. Silver and industrial metals structurally supported by AI buildout.
